scope: five core effects; no process access and no engine calls

limits.note: Direct branches inside the bounded window are followed; indirect calls and branches remain evidence edges. UI/script side effects are not exhaustively modeled.

relation_lookup.summary: country+0x1510 is the relation-record array; record stride 0x48. record+0 points to the owner's index root, record+0x10 is the other country handle. Each selected index uses 16-byte elements {int32 country_slot at +0, relation pointer at +8}.

improve_incoming.evidence: setter a6a390 uses root+1e0 container; getter a6a450

relation_common.summary: Effect relationship objects have actor at +0x10, target at +0x18 and start rawdate at +0x20. +0x28 is written zero by apply and one by removal. Removal can immediately free the object; re-resolve the index after each snapshot instead of retaining a removed pointer.

improve_apply.summary: value=true creates the improve relation; actor->target outgoing index and target->actor incoming index reference the same directional object. Common settlement links its +0x30 to the actor's selected diplomat mission. This is stronger evidence than free-count decline.

improve_cancel.summary: value=false finds the actor->target outgoing relation, unregisters it, clears outgoing and reverse incoming indexes, sets removed and frees the 0x48 object. Opinion accumulated before cancellation is a separate quantity and is not proof that the task still exists.

guarantee_apply_cancel.summary: value=true creates actor-guarantees-target object; both bilateral guarantee indexes reference it, so map membership alone cannot establish direction. value=false removes the indexed object. Verify object actor/target handles and +0x28=0 while it is registered.

marriage_accept_cancel.summary: Positive marriage only creates the relation for action+0x34==2 (accepted response). state=1 takes rejection handling; initial state=0,value=true does not create marriage. Initial state=0,value=false removes the marriage from both indexes.

vassal_accept_cancel.summary: Positive vassal action only creates dependency for state=2,value=true. Creation passes actor as overlord and target as subject. Its 0x90 relation has a subject-definition pointer at +0x40. Cancel value=false removes the existing relation and refreshes both countries' overlord fields. A dependency-type name is needed to distinguish vassal from other subjects.

overlord_observation.summary: country+0x18f0 is refreshed from directional dependency objects: first invalidated, then set to the country whose handle matches relationship+0x10. +0x18f7 is the handle validity byte. Observe target.overlord==actor together with the correct active dependency relation/type; actor's subject vector at +0x1a18..+0x1a20 is updated too.

envoy_mission_identity.summary: Actor diplomat manager vector contains entry pointers; entry+0x44 is ID and +0x10 mission. Mission vtable is 0x1c4b2b8, +0x80 actor, +0x88 target, +0xa8 action token, +0x50 envoy ID, +0x48 entry pointer. Initial +0x20 comes from action date; +0x24 is computed travel end. These dates are overwritten when returning, not immutable send timestamps.

envoy_status_limit.summary: Creation can set status byte 1; settlement of persistent missions sets 2. Returning missions can remain present/busy. Status and count are supporting observations only, not an action-type discriminator or proof of acceptance.

spy_apply.summary: Common settlement creates token 0x3378 task vtable 0x1ce3ba0,size 0x50, links mission+0xa0, writes task+0x2c envoy ID and task+0x18 actor, task+0x20 target. Setter ORs 0x08 in actor->target relation+0x46. The target country's +0x14b0 object owns task list head+0x4f0, tail+0x4f8,count+0x500. This object must not be mistaken for the country itself.

spy_growth_cancel.summary: Task+0x58 virtual af0880 updates actor->target relation+0x18 signed WORD and clamps to 0..10000. Public/display scaling is not proven by this function alone. Cancellation calls return path 25a3c0, then 25a680 removes task from list, calls task+0x80 (af09e0 clears bit8), destroys task and clears mission+0xa0. This does not zero accumulated network size.

reply_state_machine.summary: For state=0,response-required actions, the AI path clones then calls +0xb8; that wrapper calls +0x120 and returns score>=1. It writes response clone+0x34 = 1 + accepted, wraps and submits a response command. State 1 is rejection and 2 acceptance. Guarantee/improve/spy have +0xd0=false; marriage+0xd0 returns value; vassal returns state==0 && value. The two negotiated actions may also be queued for a human reply.
reply_state_machine.limitation: AI score functions include native game rules and optional console-cheat branch; do not replace them with a hardcoded acceptance formula.

pending_reply_queue.summary: Human/pending recipient country queue uses +0x18d8 head,+0x18e0 tail,+0x18e8 DWORDcount. Node +0 action,+8 previous,+0x10 next,+0x18 deleted byte. Queued clone receives +0x3c ID and +0x2c current rawdate. A matching queued state=0 action means pending, not accepted. Queue disappearance without observing a response is not proof of rejection.

non_proofs.summary: Transport return, consumed command container, cooldown update, fewer free diplomats, dirty cache byte and absence of a relationship are not individually effect/accept/reject proof. Several relationship setters OR relation+0x46 with 4 and set country+0x2884=1 on both addition and removal; these are refresh markers, not active guarantee/marriage bits.

acceptance_requirements: Pin executable/module, validate full current country handles and re-resolve all pointers each snapshot.
Record before/after same-pair relationship objects, vtables, actor/target, active byte, start rawdate and type.
For persistent missions, correlate selected diplomat ID, mission token/handles, relationship/task pointer and active bit.
For negotiated actions, record pending action ID and observed response state; persistent relationship proves resulting state only.
A cancelled relation/task must disappear from its live indexes; do not dereference the freed prior pointer.
Bound every vector/list count, verify stable snapshots and readable pointers; uncertain/inconsistent reads stay unknown.
